$comment: Website alerts (CORE_CONTRACTS §32). Non-secret alert settings, copied UNCHANGED into every repo that sends alerts (every client site repo with the starter, agent-website-builder reads starter/alerts.json, rgp-lead-router). Change them here (owner approval) and re-copy; never per repo. The two secrets are GitHub ORGANIZATION secrets, never in a file: SLACK_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL (Slack incoming webhook bound to the channel below) and CLICKUP_API_TOKEN (ClickUp personal API token, pk_…). A missing secret skips that channel and the GitHub issue is still opened. Read by scripts/lib/site-alert.mjs.
